Rishi / Jane —

Quick legal update on MSA redlines after internal review:

Open items (top 3, with proposed position):
1) Data retention clause: Acme requested a 7-year retention exception for audit logs. We propose: keep standard 90-day deletion for inference logs; agree to provide aggregated audit extracts on request under NDA. If Acme insists on 7-year retention, we need a commercial uplift and an exceptions process.
2) Indemnity cap: Acme wants a separate carveout for third-party IP claims; we can accept material IP claims tied to our gross negligence but cannot accept unlimited carveouts. Need procurement to confirm commercial comfort.
3) Subprocessors: Acme asked for a list of subprocessors and the right to block specific vendors. We'll provide the list; blocking would require contract-level change and limited carveouts (operationally heavy).

If procurement is comfortable with a commercial uplift for retention or an exceptions flow, legal can deliver a clean redline by 2025-09-11. Otherwise, we should plan a short call with Jane and Acme legal to negotiate the retention language next week.
